name: Cerro León from Estancia La Oriental
note: Park route from the Centro Operativo / Estancia La Oriental up Cerro León, with views over Lagos Belgrano and Volcán. Strong wind, no shops, no cell coverage; register at the Centro Operativo Clemente Onelli (09:00–19:00). Park open 1 Oct–30 Apr; the road in is long gravel (RP37 or RP41 4x4). Entry fee unconfirmed.

name: Península Belgrano circuit (Mirador Lago Belgrano)
note: Panoramic loop on the Belgrano peninsula with refugios; the small circuit is the one to do in a day, the large one is rated high difficulty. Trailhead location is unconfirmed; ask at the Centro Operativo. Register on arrival.

name: Mirador Lago Volcán
note: Easy walk to the shore of Lago Volcán from a parking spot 3 km from El Rincón. Pairs well with Cerro León. Register at the Centro Operativo.

name: Laguna de los Témpanos
area: PN Perito Moreno (AR), San Lorenzo sector
note: Walk from the Agreste camp / domos to the Témpanos lagoon below Cerro San Lorenzo, with one river crossing (depth unknown; do not go if above the knee). Far from the Posadas side; verify the road and the crossing with rangers. Domos, refugios and camping are paid in 2026-27.

name: Cerro La Calle and Laguna Coa
note: Marked park trail from Estancia La Ascensión (17 km from Los Antiguos, RP43 gravel) to Cerro La Calle and Laguna Coa. Free, sign in at the portal; national park land, so no estancia permission needed. Check whether the 10.5 km is a loop or one way.

name: Cerro Negro (Virgen del Camino)
note: Short summit walk (575 m) from the Virgen del Camino shrine on RP43. Good to pair with Laguna Coa. Free.

name: La Meseta trail to the Puesto El Rincón dome
note: Official 'A la Meseta' route: about 12–13 km from La Ascensión to the free dome and walk-in camp at Puesto El Rincón, then back the next day. Highest-demand trail of the portal; carry water and wind-proof gear, register at the portal, no advance booking per the park. Confirm water and track condition with staff.
